import json, subprocess, sys

cmds = []
def add(c, note=""):
    cmds.append((c, note))

add({"op":"about"})
add({"op":"audit","at":[0]}, "not loaded")
add({"op":"advance","time":5}, "not loaded")
add({"op":"bogus"}, "unknown op")
add({"op":"load","n":4,"links":[[0,1,10],[1,2,10],[2,3,10],[0,3,5]],
     "bookings":[{"id":"b1","owner":"o1","window":[0,100],"envelope":[[0,3],[1,3]]}]}, "first load")
add({"op":"load","n":4,"links":[[0,1,10]],"bookings":[]}, "already loaded (structurally valid)")
add({"op":"load","n":4,"links":[[0,1,10],[0,1,10]],"bookings":[]}, "invalid: duplicate unordered pair while loaded")
add({"op":"audit","at":[0,5]})
add({"op":"audit","at":[]}, "empty at")
add({"op":"audit","at":[100]}, "tick beyond window: booking inactive")
add({"op":"audit","at":[0,0,5,5]}, "duplicates preserved")
add({"op":"audit","at":[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]}, "invalid: 9 ticks")
add({"op":"audit","at":[-1]}, "invalid: negative tick")
add({"op":"advance","time":30})
add({"op":"audit","at":[29]}, "TIME")
add({"op":"audit","at":[30,99]})
add({"op":"advance","time":100}, "expire b1")
add({"op":"audit","at":[100]}, "no leases")
add({"op":"edit","rev":3,"changes":[[0,3]],"force":false}, "stale rev")
add({"op":"edit","rev":4,"changes":[[0,3],[0,4]],"force":false}, "invalid dup link")
add({"op":"edit","rev":4,"changes":[[7,3]],"force":false}, "REFERENCE")
add({"op":"edit","rev":4,"changes":[[0,3]],"force":0}, "invalid: force not bool")
add({"op":"edit","rev":4,"changes":[[0,3]],"force":false}, "no-op advance-safe edit ok")
add({"op":"edit","rev":5,"changes":[[0,2]],"force":true}, "force edit, no leases")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p1","owner":"own","window":[100,110],"period":5,
     "participants":[[0,2],[2,1]],"envelope":[[0,4],[1,4],[2,4],[3,4]],"rev":6}, "compile")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p1","owner":"own","window":[100,110],"period":5,
     "participants":[[2,1],[0,2]],"envelope":[[3,4],[1,4],[0,4],[2,4]],"rev":6}, "replay (reordered)")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p1","owner":"own","window":[100,120],"period":5,
     "participants":[[0,2],[2,1]],"envelope":[[0,4],[1,4],[2,4],[3,4]],"rev":6}, "CONFLICT")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"b1","owner":"o1","window":[100,110],"period":5,
     "participants":[[0,2],[2,1]],"envelope":[[0,4]],"rev":6}, "CONFLICT with load id")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p2","owner":"own","window":[100,110],"period":5,
     "participants":[[0,2],[2,1]],"envelope":[[0,4]],"rev":5}, "stale")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p2","owner":"own","window":[100,110],"period":5,
     "participants":[[0,2],[2,9]],"envelope":[[0,4]],"rev":6}, "REFERENCE")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p2","owner":"own","window":[90,110],"period":5,
     "participants":[[0,2],[2,1]],"envelope":[[0,4]],"rev":6}, "TIME")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p2","owner":"own","window":[100,113],"period":5,
     "participants":[[0,2],[2,1]],"envelope":[[0,4]],"rev":6}, "WINDOW")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p2","owner":"own","window":[100,110],"period":5,
     "participants":[[0,0],[2,1]],"envelope":[[0,4]],"rev":6}, "invalid dup participant")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p2","owner":"own","window":[100,110],"period":5,
     "participants":[[0,2],[2,1]],"envelope":[[0,4],[1,1]],"rev":6}, "capacity denial expected")
add({"op":"commit","id":"p9","owner":"own","rev":7}, "MISSING")
add({"op":"commit","id":"p1","owner":"wrong","rev":7}, "OWNER")
add({"op":"commit","id":"p1","owner":"own","rev":7}, "ok fresh")
add({"op":"commit","id":"p1","owner":"own","rev":7}, "replay true")
add({"op":"audit","at":[105]})
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p3","owner":"own","window":[200,210],"period":5,
     "participants":[[0,2],[2,1]],"envelope":[[0,4],[1,4],[2,4],[3,4]],"rev":8}, "compile after commit")
add({"op":"cancel","id":"p1","owner":"own","rev":7}, "stale")
add({"op":"cancel","id":"p9","owner":"own","rev":8}, "MISSING")
add({"op":"cancel","id":"p1","owner":"bad","rev":8}, "OWNER")
add({"op":"cancel","id":"p1","owner":"own","rev":8}, "cancel ok")
add({"op":"cancel","id":"p1","owner":"own","rev":9}, "MISSING again")
add({"op":"commit","id":"p1","owner":"own","rev":9}, "GONE")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p4","owner":"own","window":[300,310],"period":10,
     "participants":[[0,1],[3,1]],"envelope":[[0,1],[1,1],[2,1]],"rev":10}, "cut denial expected (no link 3)")
add({"op":"prepare","id":"p4","owner":"own","window":[300,310],"period":10,
     "participants":[[0,1],[3,1]],"envelope":[[0,1],[1,1],[2,1]],"rev":10}, "replay denied")
add({"op":"commit","id":"p4","owner":"own","rev":10}, "DENIED")

lines = [json.dumps(c) for c,_ in cmds]
out = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","submission/main.py"], input="\n".join(lines)+"\n",
                     capture_output=True, text=True)
replies = [json.loads(x) for x in out.stdout.splitlines()]
for (c,note), r in zip(cmds, replies):
    print(f"-- {note}\n   {json.dumps(c)[:150]}\n   -> {json.dumps(r)[:400]}")
if len(replies) != len(cmds):
    print("MISMATCH count", len(replies), len(cmds))
PYEOF
